user.title: Connect to Automic
user.description: The password is used once to create an expiring API token. Only the token is stored and it is renewed automatically.

data_description.trigger_object: Automic object activated right after every change from HA (ACTIVATE_UC_OBJECT), e.g. the heating workflow. Leave empty to wait for the normal cycle.
data_description.vara_day_night: Rows DayTimeStart and NightTimeStart (hour) select the _Day or _Night column; IsSummer = Yes disables heating.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Automic
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {username} is no longer valid. Enter the password to create a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Automic
reconfigure.description: Change the connection or VARA names. The password is only needed when URL, client or user change (a new API token is created).
